results.content:
The latest biweekly reading of the Penta-CivicScience Economic Sentiment Index (ESI) decreased 2.6 points to 30.8 ahead of the July FOMC meeting, driven by renewed volatility as geopolitical conflict increased energy prices and the White House announced new tariffs.

All five of the ESI’s indicators decreased during this period. Confidence in the overall U.S. economy decreased the most, falling 8.2 points to 28.0. [...] America weighs in on topical polls every day in The CivicScience Poll of the Day. Click here to subscribe and join the conversation.
